name: OUSD (Origin Dollar)
description: Rebasing stablecoin backed by USDC via Vault strategies

name: crvUSD (Curve USD)
description: CDP stablecoin with LLAMMA soft-liquidation, multi-market collateral

name: USG (Tangent Finance)
description: Early-stage crvUSD-architecture CDP stablecoin. Borrowers mint USG against stablecoin Curve-LP collateral (StakeDAO / Convex-FXN / Curve gauges) across 12 markets; peg held by two PegKeeper pools (USG/USDC, USG/frxUSD). ~half of backing is protocol-owned PegKeeper liquidity.

name: USDD (Decentralized USD)
description: MakerDAO-fork stablecoin backed by TRX/USDT vaults and HTX Smart Allocator

name: syrupUSDC (Maple)
description: ERC-4626 share over Maple's institutional open-term lending pool

name: syrupUSDT (Maple)
description: ERC-4626 share over Maple's institutional open-term lending pool, USDT-denominated. Sister product to syrupUSDC.

name: apxUSD (Apyx)
description: RWA-backed synthetic stablecoin (non-yield) over Strategy STRC + cash + SATA. Sister product apyUSD captures yield. Pairs cross-link.

name: apyUSD (Apyx)
description: ERC-4626 yield-bearing wrapper around apxUSD. Captures STRC dividend pass-through; 30-day cooldown on canonical exit, DEX two-hop for retail.

name: STRC (Strategy preferred)
description: Strategy's Series A Perpetual Preferred Stock (STRC). TradFi-extended monitor: mNAV regime, MSTR/BTC overview, STRC monthly-reset dividend, dividend obligation and runway, and downstream portfolio exposure (Apyx + Saturn). The on-chain wrapper is a separate asset — see ?asset=strcx.

name: STRCx (Backed wrapper over STRC)
description: Backed's on-chain wrapper over Strategy's STRC preferred. Rebasing scaled-UI token whose multiplier() is issuer-set; multi-chain supply, top holders, admin posture. Scores differ from the underlying — liquidity 2.5 on a DEX-only exit against STRC's 7.0 on a listed venue.

name: MSTR (Strategy common equity)
description: Equity-holder lens on Strategy Inc. Per-share BTC NAV, balance sheet, capital structure stack, dilution trajectory, convertible maturity wall. Sibling view to ?asset=strc (credit-holder lens). Same underlying data; different framing.

name: BMNR (BitMine Immersion ETH treasury)
description: Firepower tracker for BitMine Immersion Technologies — the largest publicly-traded ETH holder (~4.5% of supply, targeting 5%). mNAV trajectory, weekly ETH-buy cadence, cash-only vs ATM firepower, runway to stated 5% target. Pure-equity ATM model (no debt, no preferred, no convertibles); BMNR is structurally simpler than MSTR but the mNAV-discount trap mechanics are the same.

name: USDat (Saturn)
description: Synthetic stablecoin from Saturn Labs. Backing is held directly by the token contract as $M (M^0 T-bill-backed) + USDC — 100% on-chain verifiable via three balanceOf reads. Sister product sUSDat captures yield.

name: sUSDat (Saturn)
description: ERC-4626 yield vault over USDat. Reserves split ~19% on-chain USDat buffer + ~81% off-chain STRC (oracle-unverified — Accountable PoR feed planned, not live). Headline 11% APY target, 30-day vesting.

name: USDai (USD.AI)
description: PYUSD-reserved synthetic dollar from Permian Labs. The USDai contract holds PYUSD directly — coverage is 100% on-chain verifiable via two reads (PYUSD.balanceOf / totalSupply), no oracle. Sister vault sUSDai carries the GPU-loan credit/yield leg.

name: sUSDai (USD.AI)
description: ERC-7540 async vault over USDai, staked into Permian's GPU/equipment-finance loan book (MetaStreet engine). totalAssets decomposes on-chain to idle + DepositTimelock escrow (committed-undrawn loans) + drawn loans. NAV-tracking yield token, not a fixed peg; 30-day epoch redemption queue.

name: USDm (Mento Dollar)
description: Reserve-backed fiat stablecoin from Mento V3. Multi-chain (Celo home, Monad spoke). Live API-driven backing; on-chain ReserveV2 sanity check on Monad.

name: Ethena USDe
description: Synthetic dollar backed by delta-hedged ETH/BTC plus stables, held across on-chain wallets, custodians, and CEX margin. Largest non-fiat-backed stablecoin tracked. Sister product sUSDe captures staking yield.

name: Ethena sUSDe
description: ERC-4626 staking vault over USDe — accrues protocol yield via rising NAV. Backed by the same reserve pool as USDe; unstaking subject to a cooldown.

name: USDS (Sky)
description: Sky's USD stablecoin (DAI's rebrand — one pool, two tokens). USDC LITE-PSM reserve + three Star allocators (Spark / Grove / Obex). On-chain vat/PSM sizes with BlockAnalitica composition look-through; backing rating tracks the system surplus/deficit (vow buffer), not a tautological 100%.

name: sUSDS (Sky Savings)
description: Sky's savings vault over USDS (ERC-4626). NAV accrues via the chi accumulator; coverage is USDS balanceOf(sUSDS) over sUSDS totalAssets() — two independent reads, so 100% means the vault holds what its shares can claim rather than a tautology.

name: thUSD (Theo Network)
description: Yield-bearing onchain dollar from Theo Network. Backed by thBILL @ NAV (T-Bill exposure) plus stables, plus an off-chain gold-carry leg. Two-token: thUSD ($1-pegged) + sthUSD (yield-bearing vault share, currently ~5.5% APY).

name: cUSD (Cap)
description: Cap's stablecoin: cUSD is over-reserved by a shared USDC/RWA vault, then re-lent to whitelisted operators (Bedrock, market-makers) whose borrows are backed by restaker first-loss collateral (Symbiotic). Peg trades DEX-only on thin liquidity — coverage + operator health are the headline signals, not price. Sister vault stcUSD captures the lending yield.

name: PRIME / wYLDS (Hastra)
description: Independent on-chain reserve monitor for Hastra's wYLDS wrapper and its PRIME staking token. Collateralization is reconstructed from raw Provenance bank balances plus the full Solana + Ethereum supply — Hastra's own Proof-of-Reserves page is not an input, so the reserve accounts it does not name (one co-mingled with Figure's loan book) are visible here. PRIME's yield is HELOC-warehouse lending, not Treasuries.

name: yzUSD (Yuzu Money)
description: Overcollateralized stablecoin on Plasma, backed by an actively managed DeFi strategy book with reserves published through Accountable. Most of the backing sits in leveraged loop positions and a slice is Yuzu's own yzPRIME, so the collateral ratio is a ratio on a levered book. Supply is entirely on Plasma; the great majority of the backing is not.

name: syzUSD (Staked Yuzu)
description: ERC-4626 vault over yzUSD, canonical on Plasma. It holds nearly all outstanding yzUSD, so its risk is pass-through to yzUSD's backing plus the vault contract rather than leverage of its own — the coverage shown here is yzUSD's.

name: reUSD (Re Protocol)
description: Tokenized SENIOR tranche of a quota-share reinsurance program. Capital in Re's Insurance Capital Layer is allocated to fully-collateralized reinsurance via licensed insurers, held in a U.S. §114 Reinsurance Trust; the liquid sleeve runs an Ethena basis / T-Bill strategy. A NAV-tracking vault share, not a $1 peg — and the share price is ADMIN-WRITTEN on SharePriceCalculator. Primary redemption is non-U.S. persons only and pays sUSDe on Mainnet (USDC on Avalanche). ⚠️ NOT Resupply's reUSD (0x57aB1E00…), a different issuer and a different asset.

name: reUSDe (Re Protocol)
description: Tokenized MEZZANINE tranche over the SAME Re Protocol reinsurance book — junior to reUSD, senior to Re's own equity. NAV-tracking vault share. ⚠️ No on-chain NAV accessor exists at all (nav(), getNAV(), totalAssets(), pricePerShare(), convertToAssets(), exchangeRate() all revert); the mark comes from Re's own api.re.xyz. Same issuer as reUSD (Resilience BVI Ltd., BVI FSC), so a matching issuer axis is correct rather than duplicated.

name: BOLD (Liquity V2)
description: Liquity V2 multi-branch CDP stablecoin minted against WETH, wstETH and rETH. Each immutable branch has independent collateral thresholds and a Stability Pool; exits split between size-bounded secondary liquidity and permissionless but size-dependent protocol redemption.

name: msUSD (Metronome)
description: Address-resolved monitor for Metronome Synth msUSD. Separates user CDP debt, the AMO's self-referential vamsUSD claim, external CDP collateral, and genuine non-synth DEX exit assets. Not Mainstreet Finance msUSD and not Mento USDm.

name: DUSD (Alto)
description: Hybrid stablecoin on Ethereum only. ~88% of supply is minted 1:1 against frxUSD in a treasury-operated stability module (722,605 DUSD against 722,604.61 frxUSD — matched to the wei, with no buffer of any kind); the remaining ~12% against an over-collateralized CDP book. ⚠️ Four live Ethereum tokens answer to DUSD/dUSD and the nearest is 3.2% away on supply, so this page resolves by contract address, never by ticker. ⚠️ The stability module's swap is permissioned to a single treasury Safe, which originated all 16 lifetime swaps — it is not a holder redemption route. A holder's only exit is one Curve pool, which also holds 97% of the supply.

name: fxUSD (f(x) Protocol)
description: f(x) Protocol's overcollateralised stablecoin, backed by wstETH and WBTC held against LEVERAGED LONG positions rather than idle collateral — so fxUSD's stress and its collateral's stress arrive together rather than independently. Two live v2 pools; ⚠️ 89.7% of debt sits on the custodial WBTC leg at the lower ratio, which the aggregate hides. ⚠️ Protocol redemption is CLOSED because the peg is holding: isRedeemAllowed() gates on a Curve EMA below $0.998, so it is a designed state gate rather than an admin switch — and an arbitrage that caps downside near $0.998, not a holder's floor. ~90% of supply is locked in the Stability Pool, leaving a tradeable float near 2%.
